title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
了解完系统的功能后，方言退出了意识空间。这具身体实在是太虚弱了，方言只感觉自己现在很是疲惫。不一会儿，方言就迷迷糊糊的睡着了。朦胧之间，方言睁开了眼睛。随着视线逐渐清晰，方言发现自己来到了一处明亮的广场！广场中央站着四五个人，有高有矮，正面带笑意的打量着方言。“不错，你是这次新人中素质最好的那一个！”一个冷厉的声音突兀的响起。方言循声望去，只见一个西装革履的大帅比正冷着脸说道。不是吧，刚刚穿越到异世界，现在居然又被轮回空间选中了？方言心中暗暗叫苦。“呵呵呵，新人，主神应该给你了一千积分吧，识相点的就快点交出来，否则别怪我们上手段了！”一个长的像高中生的俊秀少年笑眯眯地说道。靠，完了完了，居然还进入了养殖队！方言面无表情的看着几人，心中正在疯狂的思索对策。“哈哈哈，你们别吓他了，每次都是这一套，有意思吗？”一个穿着古装武侠风格的俊朗青年朗声笑道。嗯？什么意思？这是恶作剧？“算了，还是我给他解释一下吧！”一个身穿西方皮甲的帅气青年爽朗的一巴掌拍在方言的后背上。瞬间，方言的脑海中突兀的出现了好几段记忆，立刻就明白了眼前的情况！“还是这样的方法说明比较方便，现在清楚了吧，我们就是你！”皮甲青年笑着说道。方言明白过来后，立刻对着西装革履的那个男人翻了个白眼：“你还真是恶趣味啊！”西装男也露出了笑容：“哈哈哈哈哈……虽然你已经知道了我的身份，但是还是让我自我介绍一下。我是方言，穿越的世界是韩剧韩影的综合世界，目前的身份是首尔大学法律系的在校生！我也有一个垃圾的金手指，叫做超级罪犯打击系统，能力是抓到一个罪犯，就能抽一次奖，奖品都是我那个世界中只要花钱就能买到的东西。”高中生也笑着说道：“我是方言，穿越的可能是日剧《我是大哥大》的世界，目前我的身份是国中生，有个青梅竹马叫做川崎明美，就是那个着名的表情包‘明美，你说话不会看场合的吗？’里的明美！有个颜艺收集系统，只要收集到夸张的颜艺，就能获得奖励。奖励同样也没什么大用，不过是穿越前的流行文化作品什么的。”武侠风男子笑道：“我是方言，穿越到的是大明江湖世界，身份是华山派君子剑岳不群的大弟子。至于为什么说是大明江湖世界，是因为这个世界除了笑傲江湖里的人物外，我还听说了其他世界中的人物和势力。

比方说关中大侠，四大神捕，黑石杀手，青龙会等等。金手指是合影打卡系统，和影视小说中出现过的人物合影打卡，就可以获得他身上随机一样物品或技能！”皮甲帅哥同样笑着说道：“我是方言，穿越的世界是素晴，是被幸运女神厄里斯转生的。金手指是全职业精通天赋，可以无视职业限制，学习所有技能，代价是无法使用技能点，只能靠自己的力量学习。”方言也笑了，同样说道：“我叫方言，穿越的世界是辫子世界，有个堂弟叫方世玉。金手指是一套只有记事本功能的任务系统，废的不行！”连带辫子方言在内的五人一一介绍完毕后，几人相视一笑。这几人都是方言，只不过在穿越的时候，灵魂一分为五，或者更多，去往了不同的世界。身体虽然不同，但是内里的灵魂却是同一人。“话说你们认为，这个空间里，会只有我们五个人吗？”辫子方言问道。“应该不会，我们都看过那本书，也是开创了这个流派的开山之作。在那个书里，主人公杜克都能穿越99个世界，没道理我们只有五个，这也太low了！”高中生方言摩挲着还没长出胡子的下巴，一本正经的分析道。“没错，我们几个穿越的世界都太小众了，连死火海都没有，真要是写出来的话，估计又是一本扑街之作啊！”韩综方言摇头叹息道。“我也是这么认为的，”皮甲方言表示同意，“现在的书友都是lsp，要是书里不搞凰色的话，那更加不会火了！”“喂喂喂，没必要这么明目张胆的说出来吧！”武侠方言有些汗颜，“我们不是应该试验一下，这个空间对于我们的加成吗？比方说天赋实力共享什么的！”“实力恐怕没办法共享！”韩综方言摇头叹息道，“随着后面的世界越来越多，肯定会有高战力的方言出现，到时候，我们几个低魔无魔的世界，战力可能会崩溃，到时候就烂尾了！”“不过记忆可以共享，天赋也可以叠加！”高中生方言说道，“我之前是个学渣，但是自从来到这个空间之后，我感觉自己好像头脑变清晰了很多，很多以前完全不懂的东西，现在都豁然开朗了！”皮甲方言点点头：“我也有这种感觉，由于我金手指的原因，我明显感觉，自己学习技能的速度变快了，这也证明我们的天赋确实可以叠加！”“对了对了，说到记忆共享，各位大佬，有没有什么神功魔法，可以共享给小弟啊？小弟我在的世界是辫子世界，属于低武世界，应该可以学习功法的吧？！”辫子方言期待地问道。听到辫子方言的话，剩下四人都笑了，其中，皮甲方言和武侠方言是得意的笑，韩综方言和日综方言则是无奈的笑。武侠方言说道：“由于世界限制的原因，每个世界所能容纳的力量体系也不同。韩综和日综方言那里，都是无魔世界，所以无法学习我这里的武功，也无法学习皮甲方言那里的魔法！至于你，你运气还算不错，和我一样，都是低武世界，所以我这边的武功你可以学习！”
content_en:
After understanding the functions of the system, Dialect exited the consciousness space.This body is too weak, Fang Yan only feels that he is very tired now.After a while, Fang Yan fell asleep in a daze.Dimly, Fang Yan opened his eyes.As his vision gradually became clearer, Fang Yan found himself in a bright square!There were four or five people standing in the center of the square, some tall and some short, looking at Fang Yan with a smile."Yes, you are the one with the best quality among the newcomers this time!" A cold and stern voice suddenly sounded.Fang Yan looked around and saw a handsome man in a suit and leather boots, Bi Zheng said with a cold face.Isn't it right? I just traveled to another world, and now I'm selected by the reincarnation space again?Fang Yan secretly complained in his heart."Hehehe, newcomer, the Lord God should have given you a thousand points. If you are wise, please hand it over quickly, otherwise don't blame us for resorting to tricks!" A handsome young man who looked like a high school student said with a smile.Damn it, after all, I actually joined the breeding team!Fang Yan looked at the few people expressionlessly, thinking frantically in his mind about countermeasures."Hahaha, don't scare him. It's the same thing every time. Isn't it interesting?" A handsome young man wearing ancient martial arts style laughed loudly.Um?What's the meaning?Is this a prank?"Forget it, let me explain it to him!" A handsome young man wearing Western leather armor slapped Fang Yan on the back heartily.In an instant, several memories suddenly appeared in Fang Yan's mind, and he immediately understood the situation in front of him!"It's more convenient to explain in this way. Now it's clear, we are you!" The leather-armored young man said with a smile.After Fang Yan understood, he immediately rolled his eyes at the man in the suit and tie: "You are really evil!" The man in the suit also smiled: "Hahahahaha... Although you already know my identity, let me introduce myself. I am Fang Yan, and the world I travel to is the comprehensive world of Korean dramas and movies. Currently,My identity is a student of Seoul National University's Law Department! I also have a rubbish golden finger called the Super Criminal Fighting System. If I catch a criminal, I can draw a prize. The prizes are all things that can be bought with money in my world." The high school student also said with a smile: "I am dialect, and the time traveled may be from the Japanese drama "I am a big man."In the world of "College", I am currently a junior high school student, and I have a childhood sweetheart named Kawasaki Akemi, who is the one in the famous emoticon "Akimei, don't you speak according to the situation?" There is a Yanyi collection system, and the rewards are also useless as long as you collect exaggerated Yanyi.The martial arts-style man smiled and said: "I am a dialect, and I traveled to the world of the Ming Dynasty. My identity is the disciple of the Huashan sect Jian Yue Buqun. As for why it is called the world of the Ming Dynasty, it is because in addition to the characters in Xiaoao Jianghu, I have also heard about the characters and forces in other worlds.

For example, Guanzhong Heroes, Four Great Catchers, Black Stone Killers, Green Dragon Society, etc.Goldfinger is a photo check-in system. If you take a photo with a character who appears in movies, TV series, or novels, you can get a random item or skill from him!The handsome boy in leather armor also smiled and said: "I am Fang Yan, the world I traveled to is Suqing, and I was reincarnated by Eris, the goddess of luck."Goldfinger is a proficiency talent for all professions. It can ignore profession restrictions and learn all skills. The price is that you cannot use skill points and can only learn by yourself.Fang Yan also smiled and said the same: "My name is Fang Yan, the world I traveled to is the braid world, and I have a cousin named Fang Shiyu."Goldfinger is a task system that only has a notepad function. It’s useless!"After the five people, including the braided dialect, were introduced one by one, they looked at each other and smiled.These people all speak dialects, but when they traveled through time, their souls were divided into five or more, and went to different worlds.Although the bodies are different, the soul inside is the same person."By the way, do you think there will be only five of us in this space?" Braided Dialect asked."Probably not. We have all read that book, which is also the pioneer of this genre. In that book, the protagonist Duke can travel through 99 worlds. It makes no sense that we only have five. This is too low!" Fang Yan, a high school student, rubbed his chin that had not grown a beard and analyzed it seriously."That's right, the worlds we traveled through are so niche that they don't even exist in the Sea of ​​Death Fire. If it were written down, it would probably be another blockbuster!" Han Zong shook his head and sighed in dialect."I think so too," Pi Jia Fang Yan agreed, "Today's book friends are all LSPs. If the book doesn't contain phoenix sex, it will be even less popular!" "Hey, hey, there's no need to say it so blatantly!" Wuxia Fang Yan was a little embarrassed, "Shouldn't we test the bonus of this space for us? ThanFang said that there is no way to share talent and strength!" Han Zongfangyan shook his head and sighed, "As more and more worlds come, there will definitely be dialects with high combat power. By then, the combat power of our low-magic and non-magic worlds may collapse, and then we will be unfinished." "But memories can be shared, and so can talent!To superimpose!" Fang Yan, a high school student, said, "I was a scumbag before, but since I came to this space, I feel like my mind has become a lot clearer.Many things that I didn't understand before are now suddenly clear to me!" Pi Jia Fang Yan nodded: "I feel the same way. Because of my golden finger, I obviously feel that IThe speed of learning skills has become faster, which also proves that our talents can indeed be stacked!" "By the way, talking about memory sharing, do you guys have any magical skills that you can share with me? My world is a braided world, which is a low-level martial world. I should be able to learn the skills, right?"After hearing Braid Dialect's words, the remaining four people all laughed. Among them, Pi Jia Dialect and Wuxia Dialect smiled proudly, while Han Zong Dialect and Rizong Dialect smiled helplessly.The martial arts dialect said: "Due to the limitations of the world, the power system that each world can accommodate is also different. The Han Zong and Rizong dialects are both magic-free worlds, so you can't learn the martial arts from me, nor can you learn the magic from the leather armor dialect! As for you, you are quite lucky. Like me, they are both low martial arts worlds, so you can learn the martial arts from my side!"
